deployments_detail.use: AI-driven facilities management (smart building, real-time actionable building data) deployed at ISS Switzerland HQ

AI food-waste tracking in commercial/catering kitchens: Winnow Vision uses computer vision above the bin to auto-identify and weigh discarded food, giving chefs data to cut waste. ISS Belgium led the global rollout across its catering sites. [Winnow (Winnow Vision)]
deployments_detail.value: At one ISS Belgium site: food-waste cost down 57% as % of sales, ~13.5 tonnes food waste avoided, 58 tonnes CO2e prevented, ~$30,000 saved in one year

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous AI-powered floor-scrubbing cleaning robots (Avidbots Neo) deployed in ISS-managed facilities; the robots self-navigate and use AI to learn/remap pathways and avoid obstacles without staff re-teaching. [Avidbots (Neo, Avidbots Autonomy AI)]

IoT + analytics data platform (real-time temperature, humidity, CO2, noise, occupancy, waste) built to deliver comfort predictability, occupancy tracking and workplace-experience insights to ISS and its clients. [Context& and Microsoft]

Partnership integrating Microsoft Places (AI-powered connected workplace app) with the ISS Workplace App to coordinate hybrid work, analyze how physical spaces are used, and optimize resources across ISS's ~350,000 employees and client sites. [Microsoft (Microsoft Places, Microsoft 365)]
'Building on a Page' data-management tool gaining a generative-AI feature that provides automated answers to building managers' natural-language questions about building data and operations.

AI features in the ISS Workplace Experience App: AI-assisted office-visit forecasts plus chatbots supporting employee onboarding and productivity for daily workplace tasks (booking, navigation, event info). [Microsoft]

AI recruiting/hiring: conversational assistant (Paradox 'Olivia') runs a mobile-first, text-based candidate application, screening and scheduling to automate recruiter admin work at ISS Americas. [Paradox (Olivia)]

GenAI-assisted software development: 'GenAI Twin' project with Solita and the resulting CollabAI framework using on-demand AI assistants to generate test cases, data models and UI prototypes; ISS integrated the learnings into its AI strategy. [Solita (CollabAI)]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 40 validated prototypes in one hour; ~90% fewer meetings; non-technical members contributing within 1 day (project results, not production KPIs)

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI chatbots for contract analysis (answering questions like which services a contract includes) and AI assistance for drafting quotation and tender text, within ISS's global AI programme.
